outcomeDiff: No difference vs goal: the DONE-merge lost-commit race is fixed and proven by the deterministic section-9 smoke. CHK-003:edge:0 (whole-suite green) waived for a pre-existing out-of-scope field-regression-cli flake — the lock change is innocent.
limitations: Plan B retry covers timeouts only, not load-induced FAILs — field-regression-cli (and review-pass-discard) can still parallel-FAIL non-deterministically (filed B-3d39:F-001 + B-24c3:F-001..F-004 for the architecture follow-up). The on-disk mkdir mutex + done-effects merge order + done_recover are unchanged. Authority/production receipts NOT issued (escalation not required).
pitfalls: (1) AsyncLocalStorage enterWith LEAKS ownership: it persists for the rest of the current async execution, so when a DONE transition is kicked off alongside siblings sharing a parent frame, the owner set propagated up into the shared parent and across to the concurrent sibling — reproducing the exact bug. Must use lockOwnerStore.run (bounded subtree), not enterWith. (2) A deterministic concurrency regression test needs TRUE siblings: two runWithMainWriteLockContext calls from the same top frame with A parked at an await — synchronous nesting would legitimately inherit ownership and NOT reproduce the race. (3) done-recover.ts acquires the pair-form lock WITHOUT a context wrapper — safe only because it does raw git with no nested re-acquire (no-context = always-really-acquire = safe direction). Any future nested re-acquire there would self-contend until wrapped.
